request.system:
You write a short brief for an account owner in Sales at Lumen Labs. A signal has fired on one of their accounts, and they will decide whether and how to reach out. They have two minutes and have not looked at this account recently.

You are given a JSON object of facts about the account. Use only those facts. Every number you write must appear in the facts exactly as given: do not round, add, subtract, estimate or convert. If a fact is missing or null, leave it out. Do not guess at reasons the data does not show.

Write five short lines, in this order, each starting with its label:

Signal: what fired, in plain words.
Evidence: the two or three facts that matter most for this signal.
Likely need: what the customer probably needs (more seats, or the next edition), and why the evidence points there.
Suggested opener: one sentence the account owner could say or write to the customer. Helpful, not pushy.
Risks: anything in the facts that argues for caution (open high-priority tickets, a low NPS score, yellow or red health, a renewal close by). Write "none visible in the data" if there is nothing.

Plain text, no headings, no bullet symbols.

messages.content: {"account_name": "Cavolo Foods", "segment": "smb", "edition": "free", "next_edition": "standard", "arr": 0, "seats_licensed": 10, "seats_assigned": 10, "seats_assigned_30_days_ago": 10, "seat_utilisation_pct": 100, "monthly_active_users": 7, "automation_rules": 5, "automation_rule_limit": 5, "integrations": 2, "integration_limit": 2, "assist_credits_used_30d": 0, "assist_credits_included": 0, "health_score": 75.6, "health_band": "green", "open_high_priority_tickets": 0, "latest_nps_score": 10, "days_to_renewal": 207, "trigger_signal": "seat_pressure", "trigger_evidence": "10 of 10 seats assigned", "expansion_score_pct": 67, "expansion_reasons": "nearly all seats assigned, near the automation limit, free edition"}

content.text:
Signal: Seat pressure fired on Cavolo Foods, a free-edition SMB account where all 10 licensed seats are now assigned.
Evidence: 10 of 10 seats assigned (seat utilisation 100%), automation rules at 5 of 5 limit, integrations at 2 of 2 limit.
Likely need: The next edition (standard) is the likely fit rather than just more seats, since the account is on free and has hit its automation and integration limits as well as its seat cap. Seats were already fully assigned 30 days ago too, so the pressure is not new, and the limits on rules and integrations point to needing more capability.
Suggested opener: "Hi, I noticed Cavolo Foods has all 10 seats in use and has reached the automation and integration limits on your current plan, so I wanted to see whether moving to Standard would help your team keep going without hitting those caps."
Risks: Monthly active users are 7 of 10 assigned seats, so three assigned seats may be inactive, which is worth checking before pitching more capacity. ARR is 0 and the account is on free, so there is no current revenue to protect. Health is green at 75.6, there are no open high-priority tickets, the latest NPS is 10, and renewal is 207 days away.
